{{Quote|Step right up. Choose your card, let me guess which one it is. If I'm wrong, you win the pot. I've got a one in sixty-three chance. C'mon, place your bets.|Arjon F.M.P|<ref name="GG7" />}}
'''Arjon F.M.P.''', or '''F.M.P.''' to her friends, was a card shark and con artist that set up shop in the alley behind [[Docking Bay 94/Legends|Docking Bay 94]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While she had no compunctions about deceiving marks with her card tricks, she did not engage in other forms of stealing.<ref name="GG7" />
